fallback.zh: 还没对。从 {t:09:50} 跳到 {t:10:00}，从全程时间里减去这一跳。

prompt.en: Ravi starts homework at {t:16:20} and works for {d:1h55m}. When does he finish? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: Ravi {t:16:20} 开始做功课，用了 {d:1h55m}。几点完成？可以用时间线帮忙。

guide.en: Jump forwards to the next full hour. Keep track of the duration left before adding whole hours and minutes.
guide.zh: 先往后跳到整点。记下还剩多长时间，再跳整小时和剩下的分钟。

hints.en: Look at the start mark and the next full hour, {t:17:00}.
hints.zh: 看看开始标记和下一个整点 {t:17:00}。

hints.en: The jump to {t:17:00} uses {d:40m}, leaving {d:1h15m}.
Jump another {d:1h} to {t:18:00}, then add the last {d:15m}.

correct.en: Yes. The jumps of {d:40m}, {d:1h} and {d:15m} total {d:1h55m} and end at {t:18:15}.

say.en: 20 + 55 = 75 minutes includes a whole hour. Trade 60 minutes for an hour, or jump to {t:17:00} first.
say.zh: 20 + 55 = 75 分钟，里面还有一个整小时。满 60 分钟进一小时，也可以先跳到 {t:17:00}。

say.en: You subtracted the duration. Finishing comes later; start at {t:16:20} and move forwards.
say.zh: 你减去了经过的时间。结束在开始之后，请从 {t:16:20} 往后跳。

fallback.en: Not yet. Use the start mark at {t:16:20}, jump to the next hour and track the time still left.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 {t:16:20} 的标记先跳到整点，记清楚还剩多长时间。

prompt.en: A film starts at {t:10:55} and lasts {d:2h30m}. When does it end? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: 电影 {t:10:55} 开始，放映 {d:2h30m}。几点结束？可以用时间线帮忙。

guide.en: Start at the film mark and jump forwards to the next hour, then use the time left. Watch the morning and afternoon bands as you pass noon.
guide.zh: 从电影开始的标记先跳到整点，再跳剩下的时间。跨过中午时，留意上午和下午的底色段。

hints.en: Locate {t:10:55} and the noon boundary on the timeline.
hints.zh: 找到 {t:10:55} 和时间线上的中午分界。

hints.en: Use {d:5m} to reach {t:11:00}; you still have {d:2h25m}.
Two whole-hour jumps reach {t:13:00}. Add the last {d:25m} and choose pm.
hints.zh: 再跳两个整小时到 {t:13:00}。加上最后的 {d:25m}，选择 pm。

correct.en: Yes. {d:5m} to {t:11:00}, then {d:2h25m}, reaches {t:13:25}. You passed noon, so it is pm.
correct.zh: 对。先过 {d:5m} 到 {t:11:00}，再过 {d:2h25m} 到 {t:13:25}。已经跨过中午，要用 pm。

say.en: 55 + 30 = 85 minutes contains another hour. Jump to {t:11:00} first and keep the remaining duration.
say.zh: 55 + 30 = 85 分钟，里面还要进一小时。先跳到 {t:11:00}，再算剩下的时间。

say.en: That is earlier than the film starts. Add the duration by jumping forwards from {t:10:55}.
say.zh: 这个时刻比电影开始还早。请从 {t:10:55} 往后跳，加上放映时间。

say.en: The hour and minutes fit, but the film ends after noon. Look at the afternoon band and choose pm.
say.zh: 几点几分算对了，但电影在中午之后结束。看看下午的底色段，选择 pm。

fallback.en: Not yet. Begin at {t:10:55}, add the full duration, then check which side of noon you reach.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 {t:10:55} 出发，加上全部放映时间，再看看落在中午哪一边。

prompt.en: Siti visits family at {t:11:25} for {d:1h45m}. When does she leave? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: Siti {t:11:25} 开始家庭探访，逗留 {d:1h45m}。几点离开？可以用时间线帮忙。

guide.en: Jump forwards from the start of the visit to noon, then use the duration left. The end time needs am or pm.
guide.zh: 从家庭探访的开始时刻往后跳，先跳到中午，再跳剩下的时间。结束时刻要分清 am 或 pm。

hints.en: Find the start mark and {t:12:00} on the timeline.
hints.zh: 找到开始标记和时间线上的 {t:12:00}。

hints.en: Reaching {t:12:00} uses {d:35m}, leaving {d:1h10m}.
One more hour reaches {t:13:00}. Add {d:10m}; you are in the afternoon band.
hints.zh: 再过一个小时到 {t:13:00}。加上 {d:10m}，落点在下午的底色段里。

correct.en: Yes. {d:35m} to noon and {d:1h10m} after it total {d:1h45m}, so Siti leaves at {t:13:10}.
correct.zh: 对。到中午用 {d:35m}，再过 {d:1h10m}，合共 {d:1h45m}，所以 Siti {t:13:10} 离开。

say.en: 25 + 45 = 70 minutes includes one full hour. Carry that hour and check the jump past noon.
say.zh: 25 + 45 = 70 分钟，里面有一个整小时。把这一小时加上，再检查跨过中午的跳法。

say.en: Leaving is after the visit starts. Go forwards from {t:11:25} by the given duration.
say.zh: 离开在家庭探访开始之后。请从 {t:11:25} 往后跳题目给的时间。

say.en: You have the hour and minutes, but am would be before this visit. Check the noon boundary and choose pm.
say.zh: 几点几分算对了，但 am 的这个时刻在家庭探访之前。看看中午分界，选择 pm。

fallback.en: Not yet. Jump from {t:11:25} to noon, then add the time left and check am or pm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 {t:11:25} 先跳到中午，再加上剩下的时间，检查 am 或 pm。

prompt.en: Breakfast starts at {t:07:35} and takes {d:40m}. Set the clock to the finishing time.
prompt.zh: 早餐 {t:07:35} 开始，用 {d:40m}。把钟拨到结束时刻。

guide.en: The clock shows the starting time. Move forwards by the breakfast duration, with the hour hand following the minute hand.
guide.zh: 钟面显示开始时刻。往后拨够吃早餐用的时间，分针转动，时针也跟着走。

hints.en: Read the starting position and find the next full hour.
hints.zh: 先看开始时刻，再找下一个整点。

hints.en: Use {d:25m} to reach {t:08:00}, then work out the time left.
hints.zh: 先过 {d:25m} 到 {t:08:00}，再算还剩多少时间。

hints.en: 40 − 25 = 15 minutes are left. The minute hand goes on 3; keep am.
hints.zh: 还剩 40 − 25 = 15 分钟。分针拨到 3，还是 am。

correct.en: Yes. {d:25m} to {t:08:00} and {d:15m} more make {d:40m}; the clock shows {t:08:15}.

say.en: The hour hand should have passed 8 but still be before 9. Check the hour after the jump to {t:08:00}.
say.zh: 时针应该过了 8，还没到 9。先检查跳到 {t:08:00} 后的小时数。

say.en: The minute hand has moved 5 minutes too far. Count the minutes left after {t:08:00} in fives again.
say.zh: 分针多走了一大格。再把 {t:08:00} 后剩下的分钟五个五个地数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Move forwards from the starting time to the next hour, then use the remaining minutes.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从开始时刻往后拨，先到整点，再拨剩下的分钟。

reveal.en: {t:07:35} + {d:25m} = {t:08:00}; + {d:15m} = {t:08:15}. Set the minute hand to 3 and the hour hand just past 8, with am.

prompt.en: Arjun cycles from {t:13:15} for {d:1h40m}. Set the clock to the finishing time.
prompt.zh: Arjun 从 {t:13:15} 起骑车 {d:1h40m}。把钟拨到结束时刻。

guide.en: Use the clock as your starting point and move forwards by the cycling duration. Check both hands after moving through a full hour.
guide.zh: 从钟面上的开始时刻往后拨够骑车的时间。拨过一个整小时后，再检查两根针的位置。

hints.en: The clock starts at {t:13:15}; check the pm plate.
hints.zh: 钟面从 {t:13:15} 开始，留意 pm 小牌。

hints.en: Moving forwards {d:1h} reaches {t:14:15}; there is still {d:40m} to add.
hints.zh: 先往后拨 {d:1h} 到 {t:14:15}，还要加上 {d:40m}。

hints.en: 15 + 40 = 55 minutes. Count in fives and keep the hour hand just before 3.
hints.zh: 15 + 40 = 55 分钟。五个五个地数，时针应该快到 3。

correct.en: Yes. {d:1h} reaches {t:14:15}, and {d:40m} more reaches {t:14:55}; the hour hand is still before 3.

say.en: The hour hand is near 3 but has not reached it. Keep it between 2 and 3 while the minute hand points to 11.
say.zh: 时针快到 3，但还没到。分针指 11 时，时针应在 2 和 3 之间。

say.en: You stopped the minute hand 5 minutes early. Count the remaining minutes in fives once more.
say.zh: 分针少走了一大格。把剩下的分钟再五个五个地数一次。

fallback.en: Not yet. Add the whole hour first, then the minutes; check which hour number the short hand has passed.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先加整小时，再加分钟，看看短针已经走过哪个小时数。

reveal.en: {t:13:15} + {d:1h} = {t:14:15}; + {d:40m} = {t:14:55}. Set the minute hand to 11, the hour hand just before 3, and pm.

prompt.en: Farah starts baking at {t:17:40}. It takes {d:45m}. Choose the finishing time.
prompt.zh: Farah {t:17:40} 开始烘焙，用 {d:45m}。选出结束时刻。

guide.en: Add the baking duration to the starting time before choosing. You can split the duration at the next full hour.
guide.zh: 先把烘焙时间加到开始时刻上，再选择。可以先跳到下一个整点，把经过的时间分成两段。

hints.en: Find {t:17:40} and the next hour mark on the timeline.
hints.zh: 找到时间线上的 {t:17:40} 和下一个整点刻度。

hints.en: The jump to {t:18:00} uses {d:20m}.
45 − 20 = 25 minutes remain after {t:18:00}; choose a later time with pm.
hints.zh: 到了 {t:18:00} 还剩 45 − 20 = 25 分钟；选一个之后的 pm 时刻。

correct.en: Yes. {d:20m} to {t:18:00} and {d:25m} more total {d:45m}, ending at {t:18:25}.

say.en: This time is before baking starts because you subtracted the duration. Add it by moving forwards from {t:17:40}.
say.zh: 减去烘焙时间会到开始之前。请从 {t:17:40} 往后跳，加上经过的时间。

say.en: That is one hour too many. After reaching {t:18:00}, the remaining duration is less than an hour.
say.zh: 多算了 1 小时。到 {t:18:00} 后，剩下的时间还不到一小时。

say.en: This adds an extra {d:5m}. Recheck the minutes left after the first jump to {t:18:00}.
say.zh: 这里多加了 {d:5m}。重新检查第一跳到 {t:18:00} 后还剩多少分钟。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count forwards from {t:17:40}, using {d:20m} to reach the next hour first.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 {t:17:40} 往后数，先用 {d:20m} 到下一个整点。

prompt.en: A swim starts at {t:11:05} and lasts {d:1h30m}. Choose the finishing time.
prompt.zh: 游泳 {t:11:05} 开始，持续 {d:1h30m}。选出结束时刻。

guide.en: Add the duration by moving forwards from the start mark. Check which side of noon the finishing time falls on.
guide.zh: 从开始标记往后跳，加上游泳的时间。看看结束时刻落在中午的哪一边。

hints.en: Look at the start mark at {t:11:05} and the noon boundary.
hints.zh: 看看 {t:11:05} 的开始标记和中午分界。

hints.en: It takes {d:55m} to reach {t:12:00}; subtract those minutes from the duration.
hints.zh: 到 {t:12:00} 要 {d:55m}，从游泳时间中减去这些分钟。

hints.en: 90 − 55 = 35 minutes remain after noon. The finishing time uses pm.
hints.zh: 过了中午还剩 90 − 55 = 35 分钟，结束时刻用 pm。

correct.en: Yes. {d:55m} reaches noon and {d:35m} more reaches {t:12:35}; after noon the time uses pm.
correct.zh: 对。先过 {d:55m} 到中午，再过 {d:35m} 到 {t:12:35}。中午之后用 pm。

say.en: That is after midnight. This swim goes past noon; look at the afternoon band and choose the time with pm.
say.zh: 这个时刻在半夜之后。这次游泳跨过的是中午；看看下午的底色段，选择 pm 的时刻。

say.en: You have taken the duration away. Finishing is later, so go forwards from {t:11:05}.
say.zh: 你减去了经过的时间。结束在开始之后，要从 {t:11:05} 往后跳。

say.en: This includes an extra hour. After reaching noon, only {d:35m} remains; check the hour again.
say.zh: 这里多加了一个小时。到了中午还剩 {d:35m}，再检查小时数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Jump to noon first, use the duration left, then check the am or pm part of each option.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先跳到中午，再跳剩下的时间，然后检查各选项的 am 或 pm。

reveal.en: {t:11:05} + {d:55m} = {t:12:00}; + {d:35m} = {t:12:35}. The jumps total {d:1h30m} and end after noon.

caption.en: A bus trip ends at {t:16:10}. It took {d:1h25m}. When did it start? This time we know the end.
caption.zh: 一趟巴士 {t:16:10} 到站，路上用了 {d:1h25m}。它几点出发？这一次知道的是结束的时刻。

caption.en: The trip started before it ended, so go back, not forward. Jump back 1 hour to {t:15:10}.
caption.zh: 出发一定在到站之前，所以要往回推，不是往后加。先往回跳 1 小时，到 {t:15:10}。

caption.en: Then back 10 minutes to the full hour, {t:15:00}. Of the 25 minutes, 15 are still to go.
caption.zh: 再往回 10 分钟，到整点 {t:15:00}。25 分钟里还差 15 分钟。

caption.en: Back 15 more minutes: {t:14:45}. Check by going forwards: {t:14:45} + {d:1h25m} = {t:16:10}.

keyFacts.en: Finishing time − duration = starting time.
keyFacts.zh: 结束时刻 − 经过时间 = 开始时刻。

keyFacts.en: Jump back: whole hours, then back to the hour, then the minutes left.
keyFacts.zh: 往回跳：先整小时，再退到整点，最后退剩下的分钟。

keyFacts.en: Check by adding forwards from the starting time.
keyFacts.zh: 从开始时刻往前加一遍来验算。

prompt.en: A CCA practice ends at {t:12:20}. It lasted {d:1h35m}. When did it start? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: CCA 训练 {t:12:20} 结束，练了 {d:1h35m}。几点开始的？可以用时间线帮忙。

guide.en: Start at {t:12:20} and jump back: 1 hour, then back to a full hour, then the minutes left.
guide.zh: 从 {t:12:20} 往回跳：先退 1 小时，再退到整点，最后退剩下的分钟。

hints.en: Back 1 hour from {t:12:20} is {t:11:20}.
35 minutes are left: back 20 to {t:11:00}, then back 15 more.
hints.zh: 还剩 35 分钟：先退 20 分钟到 {t:11:00}，再退 15 分钟。

correct.en: Yes. Back 1 h to {t:11:20}, back 20 min to {t:11:00}, back 15 min to {t:10:45}.

say.en: That is {d:1h35m} after the end. The practice started before it ended, so go back from {t:12:20}.
say.zh: 那是结束以后再过 {d:1h35m}。训练一定在结束之前开始，所以要从 {t:12:20} 往回推。

say.en: There is no 85 minutes past an hour. When you go back past a full hour, the minutes start again from 60.
say.zh: 没有"几点 85 分"。往回退过一个整点时，分钟要从 60 往下退。

fallback.en: Not yet. Jump back from {t:12:20}: 1 hour, then to the full hour, then the rest.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 {t:12:20} 往回跳：先 1 小时，再到整点，再退剩下的。

prompt.en: You finish reading at {t:09:50} after {d:25m}. When did you start? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: 你读了 {d:25m}，{t:09:50} 结束。几点开始？可以用时间线帮忙。

guide.en: Find the end mark, then jump back by the reading time. Check by adding forwards.
guide.zh: 先找结束的标记，再往回推阅读所用的时间。最后往前加来验算。

hints.en: The end mark shows when you finished. Your start is earlier.
hints.zh: 结束标记表示结束时刻，开始时刻在它前面。

hints.en: Split {d:25m} into {d:20m} and {d:5m}, and jump back.
hints.zh: 把 {d:25m} 分成 {d:20m} 和 {d:5m}，往回跳。

hints.en: Back {d:20m} takes you to {t:09:30}. Go back {d:5m} more.

correct.en: Yes. {t:09:25} plus {d:25m} reaches the end at {t:09:50}.

say.en: You added the reading time to the end. Start at {t:09:50} and go back {d:25m}.
say.zh: 你把阅读时间加在结束时刻之后了。从 {t:09:50} 往回推 {d:25m}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the end mark and move towards an earlier time.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看结束的标记，往较早的时刻推。

reveal.en: From {t:09:50}, back {d:20m} is {t:09:30}; back {d:5m} more is {t:09:25}. That is your starting time.

prompt.en: A film ends at {t:18:15} after {d:1h40m}. When did it start? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: 电影放了 {d:1h40m}，{t:18:15} 结束。几点开始？可以用时间线帮忙。

guide.en: Go back the whole hour first, then the remaining minutes. Use a full hour as a stopping point.
guide.zh: 先往回推整小时，再退剩下的分钟。可以先退到整点。

hints.en: The end mark is the film’s ending time. Work backwards from there.
hints.zh: 结束标记是电影结束的时刻，从那里往回推。

hints.en: Back {d:1h} brings you to {t:17:15}; you still need to go back {d:40m}.
Back {d:15m} reaches {t:17:00}. Of the remaining minutes, 40 − 15 = 25.

correct.en: Yes. Back {d:1h}, then {d:15m}, then {d:25m} gives {t:16:35}.

say.en: That is after the film ended. Go back from {t:18:15} to find its start.
say.zh: 那在电影结束之后。要找开始时刻，请从 {t:18:15} 往回推。

say.en: That counts 100 minutes in an hour, but an hour has 60 minutes; go back via {t:17:00}.
say.zh: 这是把 1 小时当成了 100 分钟。1 小时只有 60 分钟，先往回退到 {t:17:00}。

fallback.en: Not yet. From the end, subtract the whole hour, then the minutes.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从结束时刻减去整小时，再减去分钟。

prompt.en: Lunch ends at {t:12:40} after {d:55m}. When did it start? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: 午餐用了 {d:55m}，{t:12:40} 结束。几点开始？可以用时间线帮忙。

guide.en: Work back from the end and watch where you cross noon. Choose am or pm for the starting time.
guide.zh: 从结束时刻往回推，留意是否退过中午。再确定开始时刻是上午还是下午。

hints.en: Find the end mark on the afternoon side of the timeline.
hints.zh: 先找时间线下午这一段的结束标记。

hints.en: Go back {d:40m} to {t:12:00}. You still have {d:15m} to go.
Go back the last {d:15m} into the morning side of the line.
hints.zh: 再退最后的 {d:15m}，就到上午这一段了。

correct.en: Yes. Back {d:55m} crosses noon to {t:11:45}, so the start is in the morning.
correct.zh: 对。往回推 {d:55m}，退过中午到 {t:11:45}，所以开始时刻在上午。

say.en: You moved later than the end. Find the start by going back {d:55m} from {t:12:40}.
say.zh: 你推到了结束之后。要找开始时刻，从 {t:12:40} 往回推 {d:55m}。

say.en: That counts 100 minutes in an hour. An hour has 60 minutes: jump back to {t:12:00} first.
say.zh: 这是把 1 小时当成了 100 分钟。1 小时只有 60 分钟，先退到 {t:12:00}。

say.en: The clock-face reading matches, but you have gone back before noon. Choose am for the start.
say.zh: 钟面读数相同，但你已退到中午之前。开始时刻应选上午。

fallback.en: Not yet. Go back to noon first, then subtract the minutes still left.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先往回推到中午，再退剩下的分钟。

prompt.en: A visit ends at {t:17:25} after {d:2h30m}. When did it start? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: 家庭探访用了 {d:2h30m}，{t:17:25} 结束。几点开始？可以用时间线帮忙。

guide.en: Take back the whole hours, then split the minutes at a full hour. Add forwards to check.
guide.zh: 先往回推整小时，再把分钟分两段退到整点前后。最后往前加来验算。

hints.en: The visit started to the left of the end mark.
hints.zh: 家庭探访的开始时刻在结束标记的左边。

hints.en: Back {d:2h} from {t:17:25} is {t:15:25}. There are {d:30m} left.
Back {d:25m} reaches {t:15:00}. Go back the last {d:5m}.

correct.en: Yes. Back {d:2h30m} gives {t:14:55}; adding that duration reaches {t:17:25}.
correct.zh: 对。往回推 {d:2h30m} 是 {t:14:55}，再加上这段时间正好到 {t:17:25}。

say.en: You added the visit’s duration after the end. Go back from {t:17:25} instead.
say.zh: 你把家庭探访所用的时间加在结束之后了。请从 {t:17:25} 往回推。

say.en: That counts 100 minutes in an hour. An hour has 60 minutes: go back to {t:15:00} first.
say.zh: 这是把 1 小时当成了 100 分钟。1 小时只有 60 分钟，先退到 {t:15:00}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Subtract {d:2h} first, then take away all of the remaining {d:30m}.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先减去 {d:2h}，再减去剩下的 {d:30m}。

prompt.en: Craft time ends at {t:14:00} after {d:1h15m}. When did it start? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: 手工课上了 {d:1h15m}，{t:14:00} 结束。几点开始？可以用时间线帮忙。

guide.en: Start at the end and subtract the hours, then the minutes. Keep track of which side of noon you reach.
guide.zh: 从结束时刻往回减，先减小时，再减分钟。留意最后在中午之前还是之后。

hints.en: The end is at a full hour. Your start must be earlier.
hints.zh: 结束时刻是整点，开始时刻一定更早。

hints.en: Back {d:1h} from {t:14:00} is {t:13:00}.
Go back {d:15m} more. You are still after noon, so use pm.
hints.zh: 还要退 {d:15m}。退完仍在中午之后，要选下午。

correct.en: Yes. Back {d:1h15m} reaches {t:12:45}, which is after noon.
correct.zh: 对。往回推 {d:1h15m} 到 {t:12:45}，仍在中午之后。

say.en: That is later than the finishing time. Subtract {d:1h15m} from {t:14:00}.
say.zh: 那比结束时刻还晚。请从 {t:14:00} 减去 {d:1h15m}。

say.en: An hour gives you 60 minutes to subtract from. Go back {d:15m} from {t:13:00}.
say.zh: 1 小时要换成 60 分钟再减。从 {t:13:00} 往回推 {d:15m}。

say.en: You are in the hour after noon, not after midnight. Choose pm for this starting time.
say.zh: 这个时刻在中午之后，不是半夜之后。开始时刻应选下午。

fallback.en: Not yet. Take away the whole hour first, then the remaining minutes, and check am or pm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先退整小时，再退剩下的分钟，并检查上午或下午。

prompt.en: A swimming lesson ends at {t:10:35} after {d:50m}. When did it start?
prompt.zh: 游泳课上了 {d:50m}，{t:10:35} 结束。几点开始？

guide.en: The clock shows the end, so work backwards by the lesson’s length. Write the starting time with am or pm.
guide.zh: 钟面显示结束时刻，要往回推上课所用的时间。写开始时刻时要选上午或下午。

hints.en: Use the time on the clock as your finishing time.
hints.zh: 把钟面上的时刻当作结束时刻。

hints.en: Go back {d:35m} to {t:10:00}, then work out the minutes left.
hints.zh: 先退 {d:35m} 到 {t:10:00}，再算还要退几分钟。

hints.en: 50 − 35 = 15. Go back that many minutes from {t:10:00}.

correct.en: Yes. Back {d:35m} and then {d:15m} gives {t:09:45}, the starting time.
correct.zh: 对。先退 {d:35m}，再退 {d:15m}，开始时刻是 {t:09:45}。

say.en: You added the lesson’s length to the end. Find the start by subtracting {d:50m}.
say.zh: 你把上课所用的时间加在结束之后了。要找开始时刻，应减去 {d:50m}。

say.en: That counts 100 minutes in an hour. An hour is 60 minutes; use {t:10:00} as a stopping point.
say.zh: 这是把 1 小时当成了 100 分钟。1 小时只有 60 分钟，可以先退到 {t:10:00}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start from the clock’s time and subtract the lesson’s duration.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从钟面上的时刻往回减去上课所用的时间。

reveal.en: From {t:10:35}, back {d:35m} reaches {t:10:00}, then back {d:15m} reaches {t:09:45}. Check: {t:09:45} + {d:50m} = {t:10:35}.

prompt.en: A journey ends at {t:13:05} after {d:1h50m}. When did it start?
prompt.zh: 行程用了 {d:1h50m}，{t:13:05} 结束。几点出发？

guide.en: Go back from the time shown on the clock. Subtract the whole hour and then the minutes, watching for noon.
guide.zh: 从钟面上的时刻往回推。先减整小时，再减分钟，留意是否退过中午。

hints.en: The clock shows the arrival, so the departure must be earlier.
hints.zh: 钟面显示到达时刻，出发一定比它早。

hints.en: Back {d:1h} is {t:12:05}; back another {d:5m} reaches {t:12:00}.
Of the 50 minutes, 50 − 5 = 45 remain. Go back from noon into the morning.
hints.zh: 50 分钟里还剩 50 − 5 = 45。从中午继续往回推，就到上午了。

correct.en: Yes. Back {d:1h50m} gives {t:11:15}; the journey began before noon.
correct.zh: 对。往回推 {d:1h50m} 得到 {t:11:15}，行程在中午之前开始。

say.en: You added the journey time after arrival. Go back from {t:13:05} to find departure.
say.zh: 你把行程时间加在到达之后了。从 {t:13:05} 往回推，才能找到出发时刻。

say.en: That counts 100 minutes in an hour. An hour has 60 minutes; go back through {t:12:00}.
say.zh: 这是把 1 小时当成了 100 分钟。1 小时只有 60 分钟，请先退到 {t:12:00}。

say.en: Going back this duration crosses noon into the morning. Keep the clock-face reading and choose am.
say.zh: 往回推这段时间会退过中午，进入上午。保留钟面读数，改选上午。

fallback.en: Not yet. Subtract the whole hour first, then go back through noon for the minutes left.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先减去整小时，再退过中午，减去剩下的分钟。

prompt.en: Aisha finishes drawing at {t:08:55} after {d:35m}. Choose her starting time.
prompt.zh: Aisha 画了 {d:35m}，{t:08:55} 结束。选出开始时刻。

guide.en: Subtract the drawing time from the finishing time. Check your choice by adding the duration back.
guide.zh: 从结束时刻减去画画所用的时间。选好后，加回这段时间来验算。

hints.en: Look for a starting time before the time on the clock.
hints.zh: 先找比钟面时刻早的选项。

hints.en: From {t:08:55}, go back {d:30m}, then {d:5m}.
Back {d:30m} is {t:08:25}. Take away the last {d:5m} and keep am.
hints.zh: 退 {d:30m} 到 {t:08:25}，还要退 {d:5m}，仍在上午。

correct.en: Yes. {t:08:20} plus {d:35m} is {t:08:55}, so you have found the start.
correct.zh: 对。{t:08:20} 过 {d:35m} 是 {t:08:55}，所以这就是开始时刻。

say.en: You added {d:35m} after the end. Work back from {t:08:55} instead.
say.zh: 你在结束之后又加了 {d:35m}。请从 {t:08:55} 往回推。

say.en: The end is in the morning, and going back {d:35m} stays in the morning. Choose am.
say.zh: 结束在上午，往回推 {d:35m} 仍在上午。请选择上午的时刻。

fallback.en: Not yet. Subtract {d:35m} from the end and check am or pm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从结束时刻减去 {d:35m}，再检查上午或下午。

prompt.en: Ravi finishes a puzzle at {t:13:40} after {d:2h}. Choose his starting time.
prompt.zh: Ravi 拼图用了 {d:2h}，{t:13:40} 完成。选出开始时刻。

guide.en: Move back by the whole hours from the end mark. Watch whether the starting time is before noon.
guide.zh: 从结束标记往回推整小时。留意开始时刻是否在中午之前。

hints.en: The end mark gives the end, and you need an earlier time.
hints.zh: 结束标记是结束时刻，要找的是更早的时刻。

hints.en: Go back {d:1h} twice; the minutes stay the same.
hints.zh: 往回退两次 {d:1h}，分钟数保持不变。

hints.en: After the first {d:1h}, you reach {t:12:40}. Go back one more hour into the morning.
hints.zh: 先退 {d:1h} 到 {t:12:40}，再退一小时就到上午了。

correct.en: Yes. Two hours before {t:13:40} is {t:11:40}, before noon.

say.en: That is {d:2h} after the end. Find the start by going back two hours.
say.zh: 那是结束之后再过 {d:2h}。要找开始时刻，应往回推两小时。

say.en: Going back two hours crosses noon into the morning. Choose the matching am time.
say.zh: 往回推两小时会退过中午，进入上午。请选择钟面读数相同的上午时刻。

fallback.en: Not yet. Go back two whole hours from the end mark and check which side of noon you reach.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从结束标记往回推两整小时，看看落在中午哪一边。

reveal.en: Back {d:1h} from {t:13:40} is {t:12:40}; back another {d:1h} is {t:11:40}. Check: {t:11:40} + {d:2h} = {t:13:40}.

caption.en: The thin hand is the second hand. It goes once round in 1 minute, which is 60 seconds, written 60 s.
caption.zh: 细细的那根是秒针。它转一圈是 1 分钟，也就是 60 秒，写作 60 s。

caption.en: For the second hand, each small mark is 1 second, just as each small mark is 1 minute for the minute hand. 15 marks: 15 seconds.
caption.zh: 对秒针来说，每一小格是 1 秒，就像对分针来说每一小格是 1 分钟。走了 15 小格：15 秒。

caption.en: This stopwatch shows 1 minute and 15 seconds. That is 60 + 15 = 75 seconds, not 115.
caption.zh: 这个秒表显示 1 分 15 秒，就是 60 + 15 = 75 秒，不是 115 秒。

caption.en: Seconds measure short times, like a race across the school field. Minutes and hours measure longer ones, like a lesson.
caption.zh: 很短的时间用秒来量，比如跑过学校操场；长一些的用分钟、小时，比如一节课。

keyFacts.en: 1 min = 60 s.
For the second hand, each small mark is 1 second.
keyFacts.zh: 对秒针来说，每一小格是 1 秒。

keyFacts.en: Seconds are for short times; minutes and hours for longer ones.
keyFacts.zh: 很短的时间用秒，长一些的用分钟和小时。

prompt.en: Wei Jie skips rope for {d:1m25s}. How many seconds is that?
prompt.zh: Wei Jie 跳绳跳了 {d:1m25s}。一共多少秒？

guide.en: 1 minute is 60 seconds. Change the minute into seconds, then add the 25 seconds.
guide.zh: 1 分钟是 60 秒。先把 1 分钟换成秒，再加上 25 秒。

hints.en: 1 min = 60 s.

say.en: That counts a minute as 100 seconds. A minute is 60 seconds: 60 + 25.
say.zh: 这是把 1 分钟当成了 100 秒。1 分钟是 60 秒：60 + 25。

fallback.en: Not yet. Change the minute into 60 seconds, then add.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把 1 分钟换成 60 秒，再加。

prompt.en: Aisha runs across the school field. How long does her stopwatch show?
prompt.zh: Aisha 跑过学校操场。秒表显示用了多长时间？

guide.en: Read the small minute dial first, then the seconds on the outer dial.
guide.zh: 先看小表盘记了几分钟，再看外圈的秒数。

hints.en: Look at the small minute dial. Has a whole minute passed?
hints.zh: 看小表盘，满一分钟了吗？

hints.en: Each small mark on the outer dial is {d:1s}.
hints.zh: 外圈每一小格表示 {d:1s}。

hints.en: The outer hand is two groups of five marks before 60.
hints.zh: 外圈的针离 60 还差 10 小格。

correct.en: Yes. No whole minute has passed, and the outer dial shows {d:50s}.
correct.zh: 对。还没满一分钟，外圈显示 {d:50s}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check the minute dial, then count the seconds on the outer dial.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看分钟小表盘，再数外圈的秒数。

reveal.en: The small dial shows no whole minutes. The outer hand points to 50, so the time is {d:50s}.
reveal.zh: 小表盘显示还没满一分钟，外圈指针指向 50，所以用了 {d:50s}。

prompt.en: Ravi times how long he holds his breath. Read the stopwatch.
prompt.zh: Ravi 用秒表记录屏气时间。秒表显示多长时间？

guide.en: Check the minute dial, then count the small marks after the nearest labelled number on the outer dial.
guide.zh: 先看分钟小表盘，再从外圈最近的数字起数小格。

hints.en: The small dial shows no complete minutes.
hints.zh: 小表盘显示还没有满一分钟。

hints.en: On the outer dial, start at 25 and count on to the hand.
hints.zh: 在外圈从 25 起，数到指针的位置。

hints.en: There are three small marks after 25: add 25 + 3.
hints.zh: 指针在 25 后第三小格，算 25 + 3。

correct.en: Yes. The hand is three marks after 25, so the stopwatch shows {d:28s}.
correct.zh: 对。指针在 25 后第三小格，秒表显示 {d:28s}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count every small mark after 25; each one is {d:1s}.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 25 起逐格数，每小格是 {d:1s}。

reveal.en: No whole minute has passed. On the outer dial, 25 + 3 = 28, so the time is {d:28s}.
reveal.zh: 还没满一分钟。外圈读数是 25 + 3 = 28，所以用了 {d:28s}。

prompt.en: Mei Ling finishes skipping rope. How long does the stopwatch show?
prompt.zh: Mei Ling 跳绳结束了。秒表显示用了多长时间？

guide.en: The small dial counts whole minutes. Read it together with the seconds on the outer dial.
guide.zh: 小表盘记录整分钟数，要和外圈的秒数合起来读。

hints.en: Look at both dials, not just the outer hand.
hints.zh: 先看两个表盘，别漏看小表盘。

hints.en: The small dial records {d:2m} in complete minutes.
hints.zh: 小表盘记录的整分钟数是 {d:2m}。

hints.en: Read the outer hand at 40 and keep the whole minutes too.
hints.zh: 外圈指针指向 40，作答时也要写上整分钟数。

correct.en: Yes. The small dial records {d:2m}, and the outer dial adds {d:40s}.
correct.zh: 对。小表盘记录了 {d:2m}，外圈还显示 {d:40s}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the whole minutes on the small dial before the seconds on the outer dial.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先读小表盘的整分钟数，再读外圈的秒数。

reveal.en: The small dial shows {d:2m} and the outer dial shows {d:40s}, giving {d:2m40s}.
reveal.zh: 小表盘显示 {d:2m}，外圈显示 {d:40s}，合起来是 {d:2m40s}。

prompt.en: A microwave runs for {d:1m40s}. How many seconds is that?
prompt.zh: 微波炉加热了 {d:1m40s}。一共多少秒？

guide.en: Change each whole minute into seconds, then add the remaining seconds.
guide.zh: 先把整分钟换成秒，再加上剩下的秒数。

hints.en: Find the whole minutes and the remaining seconds.
hints.zh: 先找出整分钟和剩下的秒数。

hints.en: {d:1m} equals {d:60s}.

correct.en: Yes. Changing the minute into seconds gives 60 + 40 = 100 seconds.
correct.zh: 对。把整分钟换成秒，得到 60 + 40 = 100 秒。

say.en: That counts 100 seconds in a minute. Use {d:60s} for each minute, then add 40.
say.zh: 这是把 1 分钟当成了 100 秒。一分钟应换成 {d:60s}，再加 40。

fallback.en: Not yet. Replace the whole minute with {d:60s}, then add the remaining seconds.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把整分钟换成 {d:60s}，再加剩下的秒数。

prompt.en: Arjun skips rope for {d:1m10s}. How many seconds is that?
prompt.zh: Arjun 跳绳跳了 {d:1m10s}。一共多少秒？

guide.en: Separate the whole minute from the extra seconds. Convert the minute before adding.
guide.zh: 把整分钟和多出的秒数分开，先换算整分钟再相加。

hints.en: Look at the small minute dial and the outer seconds dial.
hints.zh: 看分钟小表盘和外圈的秒数。

hints.en: One full turn of the outer hand takes {d:60s}.
hints.zh: 外圈指针转一整圈是 {d:60s}。

hints.en: Add the extra seconds: 60 + 10.
hints.zh: 再加上多出的秒数：60 + 10。

correct.en: Yes. One whole minute and the extra seconds give 60 + 10 = 70 seconds.
correct.zh: 对。整分钟换成秒后再相加，60 + 10 = 70 秒。

say.en: That counts 100 seconds in a minute. A full turn is {d:60s}; add 10 to that.
say.zh: 这是把 1 分钟当成了 100 秒。一整圈是 {d:60s}，再加 10。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count {d:60s} for the full turn, then add the extra seconds.
fallback.zh: 还没对。一整圈是 {d:60s}，再加上多出的秒数。

prompt.en: Daniel runs a race on the school field in {d:95s}. Write this in minutes and seconds.
prompt.zh: Daniel 在学校操场赛跑用了 {d:95s}。写成几分几秒。

guide.en: Group the seconds into full minutes, then keep the seconds left over.
guide.zh: 每满一分钟就分成一组，再写出剩下的秒数。

hints.en: Look for full groups of {d:60s}.
hints.zh: 找出有几组 {d:60s}。

hints.en: Each group of {d:60s} makes {d:1m}.
hints.zh: 每组 {d:60s} 换成 {d:1m}。

hints.en: Take away one group: 95 − 60. Keep the rest as seconds.
hints.zh: 先减去一组：95 − 60，余下的数写在秒数栏。

correct.en: Yes. 95 = 60 + 35, so there is one whole minute with seconds left over.
correct.zh: 对。95 = 60 + 35，所以是一整分钟再加余下的秒数。

say.en: That waits for 100 seconds before making a minute. Every 60 seconds make 1 minute.
say.zh: 这是等到 100 秒才进一分钟。每满 60 秒就是 1 分钟。

fallback.en: Not yet. Change each group of {d:60s} into {d:1m}, then count what is left.
fallback.zh: 还没对。每 {d:60s} 换成 {d:1m}，再数剩下的秒数。

prompt.en: Farah brushes her teeth for {d:145s}. Write this in minutes and seconds.
prompt.zh: Farah 刷牙用了 {d:145s}。写成几分几秒。

guide.en: Count how many groups of {d:60s} fit into the total. The rest stays in the seconds box.
guide.zh: 先数总秒数里有几组 {d:60s}，余下的数写在秒数栏。

hints.en: Find the complete minutes in the stopwatch reading.
hints.zh: 先找出秒表记录了几个整分钟。

hints.en: Two groups of 60 make 120 seconds.
hints.zh: 两组 60 是 120 秒。

hints.en: Use {d:2m} in complete minutes, then find 145 − 120.
hints.zh: 先写整分钟数 {d:2m}，再算 145 − 120。

correct.en: Yes. 145 = 60 + 60 + 25, giving two whole minutes and the seconds left over.
correct.zh: 对。145 = 60 + 60 + 25，是两个整分钟再加余下的秒数。

say.en: That makes a minute out of 100 seconds. Use groups of 60; check how many fit into 145.
say.zh: 这是把 100 秒当成了 1 分钟。应按每 60 秒分组，再看 145 里有几组。

fallback.en: Not yet. Group in 60s and keep track of how many full minutes you make.
fallback.zh: 还没对。每 60 秒分一组，数清换成了几个整分钟。

prompt.en: A microwave runs for {d:1m20s}. Which stopwatch shows this duration?
prompt.zh: 微波炉加热了 {d:1m20s}。哪个秒表显示这段时间？

guide.en: Compare the small minute dial and the outer seconds dial in each option.
guide.zh: 比较每个选项的分钟小表盘和外圈秒数。

hints.en: Read both dials in each option.
hints.zh: 先读每个选项的两个表盘。

hints.en: {d:1m} uses {d:60s}, then the remaining seconds start from zero.
hints.zh: 满 {d:60s} 就是 {d:1m}，然后重新记录余下的秒数。

hints.en: Look for {d:1m} on the small dial and the outer hand at 20.
hints.zh: 找出小表盘记了 {d:1m}、外圈指针指向 20 的秒表。

correct.en: Yes. That stopwatch records {d:1m} and {d:20s} more.
correct.zh: 对。这个秒表记录了 {d:1m}，再多 {d:20s}。

say.en: That stopwatch shows 100 + 20 seconds, as if a minute had 100 seconds. Use {d:60s} per minute; check both dials.
say.zh: 这个秒表显示的是 100 + 20 秒，好像 1 分钟有 100 秒。一分钟是 {d:60s}，再看两个表盘。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check the small minute dial as well as the outer seconds dial.
fallback.zh: 还没对。除了外圈秒数，也要看分钟小表盘。

reveal.en: Stopwatch B shows {d:1m20s}, equal to {d:80s}. Stopwatch A shows {d:120s}, which is {d:2m}.
reveal.zh: 秒表 B 显示 {d:1m20s}，也就是 {d:80s}。秒表 A 显示 {d:120s}，也就是 {d:2m}。

prompt.en: Siti brushes her teeth for {d:1m50s}. Which stopwatch matches?
prompt.zh: Siti 刷牙用了 {d:1m50s}。哪个秒表显示这段时间？

guide.en: Match the whole minutes first, then compare the remaining seconds.
guide.zh: 先核对整分钟数，再比较余下的秒数。

hints.en: Check how many full minutes each small dial records.
hints.zh: 看每个小表盘记录了几个整分钟。

hints.en: Convert the target to seconds by adding 60 + 50.
hints.zh: 把题目的时间换成秒，算 60 + 50。

hints.en: Choose the small dial at {d:1m} with the outer hand at 50.
hints.zh: 选小表盘记了 {d:1m}、外圈指针指向 50 的秒表。

correct.en: Yes. The small dial records {d:1m}, and the outer hand records {d:50s} more.
correct.zh: 对。小表盘记录了 {d:1m}，外圈指针还记录了 {d:50s}。

say.en: That stopwatch shows 100 + 50 seconds. A minute contributes 60 seconds; compare the minute dial again.
say.zh: 这个秒表显示的是 100 + 50 秒。一分钟应换成 60 秒，再核对分钟小表盘。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the minute dial first, then the extra seconds on the outer dial.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先读分钟小表盘，再读外圈多出的秒数。

reveal.en: Stopwatch A shows {d:1m50s} = {d:110s}. Stopwatch B shows {d:150s}, which is {d:2m30s}.
reveal.zh: 秒表 A 显示 {d:1m50s} = {d:110s}。秒表 B 显示 {d:150s}，也就是 {d:2m30s}。

caption.en: The 24-hour clock counts the hours of the whole day from midnight, {t:00:00|24}, up to {t:23:59|24}. It needs no am or pm.
caption.zh: 24 小时计时法从半夜 12 点 {t:00:00|24} 开始，把一整天的钟点一直数到 {t:23:59|24}，不用写 am 或 pm。

caption.en: Morning times keep their numbers: {t:07:30} is {t:07:30|24}. There are always four digits, so a 0 goes in front.
caption.zh: 上午的时刻数字不变：{t:07:30} 是 {t:07:30|24}。24 时制总写四位数，所以前面补一个 0。

caption.en: After noon, add 12 to the hour: {t:15:15} is 3 + 12 = 15, so {t:15:15|24}. Adding 10 would give {t:13:15|24}, which is {t:13:15}.
To go back, take 12 away: 19 − 12 = 7, so {t:19:10|24} is {t:19:10}. The small numbers inside this face are the hours after noon.
caption.zh: 反过来，小时数减去 12：19 − 12 = 7，所以 {t:19:10|24} 是 {t:19:10}。钟面里圈的小数字，就是中午以后的钟点。

caption.en: 12 noon is {t:12:00|24}, and 12 midnight is {t:00:00|24}, the start of a new day. So {t:12:45} is {t:12:45|24}, but {t:00:45} is {t:00:45|24}.

keyFacts.en: Morning: the same numbers, written with four digits ({t:07:30|24}).
keyFacts.zh: 上午：数字不变，写成四位数（{t:07:30|24}）。

keyFacts.en: After noon: add 12 to the hour ({t:15:15} is {t:15:15|24}).
Noon is {t:12:00|24}; midnight is {t:00:00|24}.

prompt.en: Write {t:15:15} in 24-hour time.

guide.en: It is after noon, so add 12 to the hour. The minutes stay the same.
guide.zh: 这是中午以后的时刻，小时数加 12，分钟不变。

hints.en: The hour is 15; the minutes are 15.
hints.zh: 小时是 15，分钟是 15。

say.en: Afternoon hours are 12 more, not 10 more: 3 + 12 = 15.
say.zh: 下午的小时数要加 12，不是加 10：3 + 12 = 15。

fallback.en: Not yet. After noon, add 12 to the hour.
fallback.zh: 还没对。中午以后，小时数要加 12。

reveal.en: {t:15:15} is after noon: 3 + 12 = 15. In 24-hour time it is {t:15:15|24}.

prompt.en: A concert starts at {t:21:05|24}. Write the time in 12-hour time, with am or pm.
prompt.zh: 音乐会 {t:21:05|24} 开始。用 12 时制写出这个时刻，要选 am 或 pm。

guide.en: 19 is more than 12, so it is after noon. Take 12 away from the hour.
guide.zh: 21 比 12 大，所以是中午以后。小时数减去 12。

hints.en: 9 o’clock and 5 minutes, after noon.
hints.zh: 9 点 5 分，中午以后。

correct.en: Yes. 21 − 12 = 9, after noon: {t:21:05}.

say.en: Take away 12, not 10: 21 − 12 = 9.
{t:9:05|face} is right, but {t:21:05|24} is after noon, so it is pm.
say.zh: {t:9:05|face} 读对了，可 {t:21:05|24} 在中午以后，要写 pm。

fallback.en: Not yet. Take 12 away from the hour and decide am or pm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。小时数减去 12，再想想是 am 还是 pm。

reveal.en: {t:21:05|24}: 21 − 12 = 9, and it is after noon. It is {t:21:05}.

prompt.en: Write {t:16:50} in 24-hour time.

guide.en: Check the am / pm plate, then decide what to do with the hour. Keep the minutes unchanged.
guide.zh: 先看 am / pm 小牌，想想小时数要怎样换，分钟不变。

hints.en: The plate says pm, so this time is after noon.
hints.zh: 小牌上是 pm，这是中午以后的时刻。

hints.en: Add 12 to 4, then keep 50 as the minutes.
hints.zh: 小时数用 4 加 12，分钟仍是 50。

say.en: That keeps the hour as it is. Look at the pm: after noon, add 12 to 4 and keep the minutes.
say.zh: 这样写，小时数没有变。看小牌上的 pm：中午以后，4 要加 12，分钟不变。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at pm and add 12 to the hour; keep the minutes.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看小牌上的 pm，小时数加 12，分钟不变。

reveal.en: {t:16:50} is after noon. Change the hour using 4 + 12 = 16 and keep 50 minutes: {t:16:50|24}.

prompt.en: Write {t:08:15} in 24-hour time, using four digits.
prompt.zh: 把 {t:08:15} 写成四位数的 24 时制。

guide.en: Morning hours keep their value. Use two digits for the hour and two for the minutes.
guide.zh: 上午的小时数不变，小时和分钟各写两位数。

hints.en: The am plate tells you it is before noon.
hints.zh: 小牌上是 am，表示还没到中午。

hints.en: Put a 0 before the hour 8. The minute hand points at 3, which means 15 minutes.
hints.zh: 小时数 8 前补 0。分针指着 3，表示 15 分。

correct.en: Yes. The morning hour stays 8, written as 08, and the minutes stay 15: {t:08:15|24}.
correct.zh: 对。上午的小时数仍是 8，写成 08，分钟仍是 15：{t:08:15|24}。

say.en: The 3 on the clock means 3 fives, or 15 minutes. Look at the small labels outside the face: 15 minutes, and the minutes do not change.
say.zh: 钟面上的 3 表示 3 个 5 分钟，是 15 分。看钟面外圈的小数字：是 15 分，换写法时分钟不变。

fallback.en: Not yet. Keep the morning hour, add its leading 0, and read the minutes in fives.
fallback.zh: 还没对。上午的小时数不变，前面补 0，再 5 个 5 个地数分钟。

reveal.en: {t:08:15} is in the morning, so the hour is 08. The minutes are 15. Together the four digits give {t:08:15|24}.
reveal.zh: {t:08:15} 还没到中午，小时写成 08，分钟是 15。合起来四位数是 {t:08:15|24}。

prompt.en: Write {t:12:30} in 24-hour time.

guide.en: Decide whether this is the noon hour or the midnight hour. The minutes stay the same.
guide.zh: 先分清这是中午还是半夜的时刻，分钟不变。

hints.en: The pm plate tells you this is after noon, not after midnight.
hints.zh: 小牌上是 pm，表示中午以后，不是半夜以后。

hints.en: The noon hour stays 12. The minute hand on 6 means 30 minutes.
hints.zh: 中午的小时数保留 12。分针指着 6，是 30 分。

correct.en: Yes. The noon hour stays 12 and the minutes stay 30, so {t:12:30} is {t:12:30|24}.
correct.zh: 对。中午的小时数保留 12，分钟仍是 30，所以 {t:12:30} 是 {t:12:30|24}。

say.en: You have counted one extra five. Look at the minute hand on 6: it means 30 minutes, which do not change in 24-hour time.
say.zh: 你多数了一个 5 分钟。分针指着 6，是 30 分，换成 24 时制时分钟不变。

fallback.en: Not yet. This is the noon hour. Keep 12 for the hour and check the minute hand on 6.
fallback.zh: 还没对。这是中午的时刻，小时保留 12，再看指着 6 的分针。

reveal.en: {t:12:30} is in the noon hour, so keep 12 rather than use 00. Keep 30 minutes too: {t:12:30|24}.

prompt.en: Write {t:00:20} in 24-hour time.

guide.en: Find the mark near the start of the day. Think about how 24-hour time writes the midnight hour.
guide.zh: 看一天开头附近的标记，想想 24 时制怎样写半夜的小时数。

hints.en: This is just after midnight, not after noon.
hints.zh: 这是半夜以后，不是中午以后。

hints.en: Use 00 for the hour just after midnight, and keep 20 as the minutes.
hints.zh: 半夜以后的小时写成 00，分钟保留 20。

correct.en: Yes. The midnight hour is 00 in 24-hour time, so {t:00:20} is {t:00:20|24}.

say.en: {t:12:20|24} is after noon. Look at the mark near the start of the day: the midnight hour is written 00.
say.zh: {t:12:20|24} 是中午以后。看一天开头附近的标记：半夜的小时数写成 00。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look near the start of the day and use the midnight hour, keeping the minutes.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看一天开头附近，用半夜的小时数，分钟不变。

reveal.en: {t:00:20} is after midnight at the start of the day. Change the hour from 12 to 00 and keep 20 minutes: {t:00:20|24}.
reveal.zh: {t:00:20} 在一天开始的半夜以后，小时数从 12 换成 00，分钟保留 20：{t:00:20|24}。

prompt.en: Aisha visits the library at {t:14:05|24}. Write this in 12-hour time, with am or pm.
prompt.zh: Aisha {t:14:05|24} 去图书馆。用 12 时制写，要选 am 或 pm。

guide.en: Use the inner numbers to identify the hour after noon. Take 12 away and keep the minutes.
guide.zh: 看里圈的数字，认出中午以后的小时数，再减去 12，分钟不变。

hints.en: 14 is greater than 12, so this time is after noon.
hints.zh: 14 比 12 大，这是中午以后的时刻。

hints.en: 14 − 12 = 2. Keep 05 for the minutes and choose pm.

correct.en: Yes. 14 − 12 = 2, and it is after noon, so {t:14:05|24} is {t:14:05}.

say.en: That takes away 10. Look at the inner and outer hour numbers: take away 12, so 14 − 12 = 2.
say.zh: 这样是减了 10。看里圈和外圈的小时数：要减 12，14 − 12 = 2。

say.en: The hour and minutes match, but am is before noon. Look at 14 on the inner scale: it is after noon, so choose pm.
say.zh: 小时和分钟读对了，可 am 表示中午以前。看里圈的 14：这是中午以后，要选 pm。

fallback.en: Not yet. Take 12 away from the hour and check which half of the day it is.
fallback.zh: 还没对。小时数减去 12，再看这是一天的前半天还是后半天。

reveal.en: {t:14:05|24}: 14 − 12 = 2, with 05 minutes unchanged. It is after noon, so write {t:14:05}.

prompt.en: Write {t:22:35|24} in 12-hour time, with am or pm.
prompt.zh: 把 {t:22:35|24} 写成 12 时制，要选 am 或 pm。

guide.en: Locate the mark late in the day. Change the hour to 12-hour time and keep the minutes.
guide.zh: 看一天快结束处的标记，把小时数换成 12 时制，分钟不变。

hints.en: The mark is well after noon, in the evening part of the day.
hints.zh: 标记在中午以后很远的地方，是晚上的时刻。

hints.en: 22 − 12 = 10. Keep 35 minutes and choose pm.

correct.en: Yes. 22 − 12 = 10, and the mark is after noon, so {t:22:35|24} is {t:22:35}.

say.en: That takes away 10 instead of 12. Look at the hour 22 again and use 22 − 12.
say.zh: 这样减了 10，没有减 12。再看小时数 22，要用 22 − 12。

say.en: The hour and minutes match, but am is before noon. Look at the mark near the end of the day and choose pm.
say.zh: 小时和分钟读对了，可 am 表示中午以前。看一天快结束处的标记，要选 pm。

fallback.en: Not yet. Take 12 away from 22 and use the timeline to decide am or pm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用 22 减去 12，再看时间线，决定选 am 还是 pm。

reveal.en: The hour 22 becomes 22 − 12 = 10. The minutes stay 35 and the time is after noon: {t:22:35}.
reveal.zh: 小时数用 22 − 12 = 10，分钟仍是 35。中午以后选 pm，是 {t:22:35}。

prompt.en: Write {t:12:10|24} in 12-hour time, with am or pm.
prompt.zh: 把 {t:12:10|24} 写成 12 时制，要选 am 或 pm。

guide.en: Look at whether the mark is near noon or midnight. The hour 12 needs the matching am or pm.
guide.zh: 看标记靠近中午还是半夜，再给小时数 12 配上 am 或 pm。

hints.en: The mark is just after the middle of the day.
hints.zh: 标记刚过一天的中间，是中午以后。

hints.en: The noon hour uses 12 with pm. Keep 10 minutes.
hints.zh: 中午的小时数用 12，配上 pm，分钟仍是 10。

correct.en: Yes. {t:12:10|24} is just after noon, so it is {t:12:10}, with pm.

say.en: 12 with am is the midnight hour. Look at the mark just after noon: use 12 with pm.
say.zh: 12 配上 am 是半夜的时刻。看刚过中午的标记：12 要配上 pm。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find noon on the timeline and check whether its hour uses am or pm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找时间线上的中午，想想这个小时要选 am 还是 pm。

reveal.en: {t:12:10|24} is after noon, not after midnight. Keep the hour 12 and the minutes 10, and choose pm: {t:12:10}.
reveal.zh: {t:12:10|24} 在中午以后，不是半夜以后。小时保留 12，分钟保留 10，选 pm：{t:12:10}。

prompt.en: Ravi has dinner at {t:19:25}. Which option shows this in 24-hour time?
prompt.zh: Ravi {t:19:25} 吃晚饭。哪个是对应的 24 时制时刻？

guide.en: Use the evening mark on the timeline. Change only the hour when writing 24-hour time.
guide.zh: 看时间线上的晚饭标记，换成 24 时制时只改变小时数。

hints.en: Dinner is in the evening, after noon.
hints.zh: 晚饭在晚上，是中午以后的时刻。

hints.en: Add 12 to 7 and keep 25 minutes.
hints.zh: 小时数用 7 加 12，分钟仍是 25。

correct.en: Yes. Dinner is after noon, and 7 + 12 = 19, so {t:19:25} is {t:19:25|24}.

say.en: That adds 10 to the hour. Look at the evening mark: add 12, so 7 + 12 = 19.
say.zh: 这样给小时数加了 10。看晚上的标记：要加 12，7 + 12 = 19。

say.en: {t:07:25|24} is {t:07:25}, in the morning. Look for the evening time for dinner.
say.zh: {t:07:25|24} 是 {t:07:25}，在早上。看晚饭的标记，要选晚上的时刻。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the evening mark and add 12 to its 12-hour hour.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找晚上的标记，把 12 时制的小时数加上 12。

reveal.en: Option B is {t:19:25|24}. For dinner at {t:19:25}, add 12 to 7 to get 19 and keep 25 minutes.

caption.en: Timetables use the 24-hour clock. This bus leaves the interchange at {t:13:50|24} and arrives at {t:14:35|24}.
caption.zh: 时刻表用 24 小时计时法。这趟巴士 {t:13:50|24} 从换乘站开出，{t:14:35|24} 到站。

caption.en: Use the same jumps: to {t:14:00|24}, then on to {t:14:35|24}. 10 + 35 = 45 minutes on the bus.
Siti waits 20 minutes, then takes the MRT for {d:1h10m}. {t:14:35|24} + 20 min = {t:14:55|24}, and {t:14:55|24} + {d:1h10m} = {t:16:05|24}.
The whole journey is {t:13:50|24} to {t:16:05|24}: 10 min + 2 h + 5 min = {d:2h15m}. In 12-hour time she arrives at {t:16:05}.

keyFacts.en: Timetables use the 24-hour clock.
keyFacts.zh: 时刻表用 24 小时计时法。

keyFacts.en: The jumps are the same: to the hour, whole hours, then the minutes left.
keyFacts.zh: 跳法一样：先到整点，再整小时，最后剩下的分钟。

keyFacts.en: Change to 12-hour time at the end if the question asks for it.
keyFacts.zh: 题目要 12 时制时，最后再换回来。

prompt.en: A bus leaves the interchange at {t:13:50|24} and reaches the last stop at {t:15:05|24}. How long is the ride?
prompt.zh: 巴士 {t:13:50|24} 从换乘站开出，{t:15:05|24} 到终点站。路上用了多长时间？

guide.en: Jump to {t:14:00|24}, then whole hours, then the minutes left. Add the jumps.
guide.zh: 先跳到 {t:14:00|24}，再跳整小时，最后跳剩下的分钟。把每一跳加起来。

hints.en: Then 1 hour to {t:15:00|24}, then 5 minutes.
hints.zh: 再跳 1 小时到 {t:15:00|24}，最后 5 分钟。

correct.en: Yes. 10 min + 1 h + 5 min = {d:1h15m}.
correct.zh: 对。10 分钟 + 1 小时 + 5 分钟 = {d:1h15m}。

say.en: 1505 − 1350 as ordinary numbers gives 155, but an hour has 60 minutes, not 100. Jump to {t:14:00|24} first.
say.zh: 把 1505 − 1350 当普通的数来减得 155，可 1 小时只有 60 分钟，不是 100 分钟。先跳到 {t:14:00|24}。

say.en: That is one hour too many. Count the jumps between the hour marks, not the hour marks.
say.zh: 多了 1 小时。数整点之间跳了几段，不是数有几个整点。

fallback.en: Not yet. Jump to the next hour, then whole hours, then the minutes left.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先跳到整点，再跳整小时，最后跳剩下的分钟。

prompt.en: Bus: {t:07:35|24} to {t:08:20|24}. How long is the ride? Use the timeline if it helps.

guide.en: Find the departure and arrival marks. Use the timeline if it helps: jump to the hour, then add the minutes left.
guide.zh: 找出开出和到站的标记。可用时间线，先跳到整点，再加上剩下的分钟。

hints.en: Start at the bus leaves mark.
hints.zh: 从巴士开出的标记开始。

hints.en: Split the ride at {t:08:00|24}.
hints.zh: 在 {t:08:00|24} 把路程分成两段。

hints.en: Add the jumps: 25 + 20 minutes.
hints.zh: 把两段加起来：25 + 20 分钟。

correct.en: Yes. 25 + 20 = 45 minutes between the two marks.
correct.zh: 对。两个标记之间经过了 25 + 20 = 45 分钟。

say.en: Subtracting the times like ordinary numbers counts 100 minutes in an hour. An hour has 60 minutes; split at {t:08:00|24}.
say.zh: 把时刻当普通的数来减，等于把 1 小时当成了 100 分钟。1 小时有 60 分钟，先在 {t:08:00|24} 分段。

say.en: You have included an extra hour. Count the time between the marks; this ride crosses an hour mark without lasting a whole hour.
say.zh: 你多算了一小时。要数标记之间经过的时间；跨过整点，不表示经过了一整小时。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the two bus marks and split the gap at the hour.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看巴士的两个标记，在整点把中间的时间分段。

prompt.en: Ferry: {t:10:50|24} to {t:12:15|24}. How long is the trip? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: 渡轮从 {t:10:50|24} 行驶到 {t:12:15|24}，用了多久？可用时间线。

guide.en: Use the timeline if it helps. Jump to the next hour, then whole hours, then the minutes left.
guide.zh: 可用时间线。先跳到下一个整点，再跳整小时，最后跳剩下的分钟。

hints.en: Find the ferry leaves and ferry arrives marks.
hints.zh: 找出渡轮开出和抵达的标记。

hints.en: Add 10 min + 1 h + 15 min.
hints.zh: 把 10 分钟 + 1 小时 + 15 分钟加起来。

correct.en: Yes. 10 min + 1 h + 15 min = {d:1h25m}.

say.en: That counts 100 minutes in an hour, but an hour has 60 minutes. Jump to {t:11:00|24} first.
say.zh: 这是把 1 小时当成了 100 分钟，可 1 小时只有 60 分钟。先跳到 {t:11:00|24}。

say.en: You counted an extra hour mark. Look at the single whole-hour gap from {t:11:00|24} to {t:12:00|24}.
say.zh: 你多数了一个整点。看 {t:11:00|24} 到 {t:12:00|24}，中间只有一整小时。

fallback.en: Not yet. Split the ferry trip into minutes, whole hours and minutes.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把渡轮行程分成分钟、整小时和分钟。

reveal.en: The jumps are {d:10m}, {d:1h} and {d:15m}, so the ferry trip lasts {d:1h25m}.
reveal.zh: 三段分别是 {d:10m}、{d:1h} 和 {d:15m}，所以渡轮行程共 {d:1h25m}。

prompt.en: MRT: leaves {t:16:45|24}, ride {d:45m}. When does it arrive? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: MRT  {t:16:45|24} 开出，车程 {d:45m}。几点到？可用时间线。

guide.en: Use the timeline if it helps: move forwards from departure. Write the arrival in 24-hour time.
guide.zh: 可用时间线，从开出时刻往后跳。用 24 时制写到达时刻。

hints.en: The arrival must be after the MRT leaves.
hints.zh: 到达时刻在MRT 开出时刻之后。

hints.en: First jump to {t:17:00|24}.
That uses {d:15m}; you still need to jump {d:30m}.
hints.zh: 这一跳用了 {d:15m}，还要再跳 {d:30m}。

correct.en: Yes. {d:15m} to the hour and {d:30m} more reach {t:17:30|24}.

say.en: 45 + 45 = 90 minutes needs regrouping: 60 minutes make an hour. Move through {t:17:00|24}.
say.zh: 45 + 45 = 90 分钟，要把其中 60 分钟换成一小时。先经过 {t:17:00|24}。

say.en: You went back from departure. The MRT arrives later, so jump forwards from {t:16:45|24}.
say.zh: 你从开出时刻往回推了。MRT 要稍后才到，应从 {t:16:45|24} 往后跳。

say.en: That hour belongs to the morning in 24-hour time. Keep the afternoon hour on the timeline when you write the arrival.
say.zh: 这个小时数在 24 时制中表示早上。写到达时刻时，要保留时间线上的下午小时数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Add the ride time to departure and keep the 24-hour labels.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从开出时刻往后加上车程，留意 24 时制的标签。

prompt.en: Film: ends {t:21:20|24}, lasts {d:1h45m}. When did it start? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: 电影 {t:21:20|24} 结束，片长 {d:1h45m}。几点开始？可用时间线。

guide.en: Use the timeline if it helps: go back from the ending mark. Keep your starting time in 24-hour time.
guide.zh: 可用时间线，从结束标记往回推。用 24 时制写开始时刻。

hints.en: The film starts before the marked ending time.
hints.zh: 电影在标出的结束时刻之前开始。

hints.en: Go back {d:20m} to {t:21:00|24}, then back {d:1h}.
You have gone back {d:1h20m}; go back the remaining {d:25m}.
hints.zh: 已经往回推了 {d:1h20m}，还要往回推 {d:25m}。

correct.en: Yes. Going back {d:1h45m} from the ending mark reaches {t:19:35|24}.
correct.zh: 对。从结束标记往回推 {d:1h45m}，到 {t:19:35|24}。

say.en: An hour has 60 minutes, not 100. Go back through the hour marks.
say.zh: 1 小时是 60 分钟，不是 100 分钟。沿着整点往回推。

say.en: You added the film length to its ending time. The start is earlier; go back from {t:21:20|24}.
say.zh: 你把片长加在结束时刻之后了。开始时刻更早，要从 {t:21:20|24} 往回推。

say.en: That writes a morning hour in 24-hour time. Read the evening hour directly from the timeline.
say.zh: 这个小时数在 24 时制中表示早上。直接读时间线上的晚上小时数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start at the ending mark and go back by the full film length.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从结束标记开始，往回推完整的片长。

prompt.en: Ferry: leaves {t:18:35|24}, trip {d:1h50m}. When does it arrive? Use the timeline if it helps.
prompt.zh: 渡轮 {t:18:35|24} 开出，行驶 {d:1h50m}。几点到？可用时间线。

guide.en: Use the timeline if it helps. Add the whole hour and the remaining minutes, crossing an hour mark when needed.
guide.zh: 可用时间线。先加整小时，再加剩下的分钟，需要时跨过整点。

hints.en: Find the ferry departure mark. Your arrival goes to its right.
hints.zh: 找出渡轮开出的标记，到达时刻在它的右边。

hints.en: Add {d:1h} first, then split the remaining {d:50m} at the next hour.
hints.zh: 先加 {d:1h}，再把剩下的 {d:50m} 在下一个整点分段。

hints.en: From {t:19:35|24}, use {d:25m} to reach {t:20:00|24}; {d:25m} remains.

correct.en: Yes. 1 h + 25 min + 25 min takes the ferry from {t:18:35|24} to {t:20:25|24}.

say.en: 35 + 50 = 85 minutes includes a full hour. Carry 60 minutes into the hour and look again at the timeline.
say.zh: 35 + 50 = 85 分钟，其中有一整小时。把 60 分钟换成一小时，再看时间线。

say.en: You subtracted the trip time. To find arrival, move forwards from the ferry leaves mark.
say.zh: 你减去了行驶时间。要求到达时刻，应从渡轮开出的标记往后跳。

fallback.en: Not yet. Add the trip time and regroup each full 60 minutes as an hour.
fallback.zh: 还没对。加上行驶时间，每满 60 分钟就换成一小时。

prompt.en: A bus timetable says: leaves {t:09:15|24}, arrives {t:11:00|24}. How long is the ride?

guide.en: Read the departure and arrival rows. Use their two marks to find the time between them.
guide.zh: 读出开出和到站两行的时刻。根据两个标记，求中间经过的时间。

hints.en: Match each timetable row to a mark on the timeline.
hints.zh: 把时刻表的两行分别对应到时间线上的标记。

hints.en: Split the gap at {t:10:00|24}.
hints.zh: 在 {t:10:00|24} 把这段时间分开。

hints.en: Add {d:45m} and the whole-hour gap that follows.
hints.zh: 把 {d:45m} 和后面的一整小时加起来。

correct.en: Yes. {d:45m} to {t:10:00|24}, then {d:1h} to arrival, makes {d:1h45m}.

say.en: Subtracting the timetable times like ordinary numbers counts 100 minutes in an hour. An hour has 60 minutes; split at {t:10:00|24}.
say.zh: 把时刻表上的时刻当普通的数来减，等于把 1 小时当成了 100 分钟。1 小时有 60 分钟，先在 {t:10:00|24} 分段。

say.en: You included one extra hour. Count the gap from {t:10:00|24} to {t:11:00|24} just once.
say.zh: 你多算了一小时。{t:10:00|24} 到 {t:11:00|24} 这一段只算一次。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read both rows, then measure the gap between their marks.
fallback.zh: 还没对。读出两行时刻，再求两个标记之间的时间。

reveal.en: The bus leaves at {t:09:15|24}. It takes {d:45m} to reach {t:10:00|24} and {d:1h} more to {t:11:00|24}: {d:1h45m}.

prompt.en: An MRT timetable says: leaves {t:15:30|24}, arrives {t:16:10|24}. How long is the ride?

guide.en: Read both rows in 24-hour time. Split the ride at the hour between the two marks.
guide.zh: 按 24 时制读出两行时刻。在两个标记之间的整点，把车程分段。

hints.en: The first row tells you where the ride begins.
hints.zh: 第一行告诉你车程从哪里开始。

hints.en: Jump from departure to {t:16:00|24}, then to arrival.
hints.zh: 从开出时刻跳到 {t:16:00|24}，再跳到到站时刻。

hints.en: Add 30 + 10 minutes.
hints.zh: 把 30 + 10 分钟加起来。

correct.en: Yes. 30 + 10 = 40 minutes between departure and arrival.
correct.zh: 对。开出到到站之间经过了 30 + 10 = 40 分钟。

say.en: That counts 100 minutes in an hour, but an hour has 60 minutes. Split the ride at {t:16:00|24}.
say.zh: 这是把 1 小时当成了 100 分钟，可 1 小时只有 60 分钟。先在 {t:16:00|24} 分段。

say.en: Crossing an hour mark does not add a whole hour. Count only the two jumps between the MRT marks.
say.zh: 跨过整点，不表示多了一整小时。只数MRT 两个标记之间的两段时间。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the two timetable rows and add the jumps through {t:16:00|24}.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看时刻表的两行，把经过 {t:16:00|24} 的两段加起来。

prompt.en: Arjun needs to reach the stop before {t:19:00|24}. Each ride takes {d:45m}. Which bus should he take?
prompt.zh: Arjun 须在 {t:19:00|24} 前到站，车程均为 {d:45m}。坐哪班？

guide.en: Each option gives a departure time. Add the ride time, then compare the arrival with the marked deadline.
guide.zh: 各选项给出开出时刻。加上车程，再把到站时刻与时间线上的期限比较。

hints.en: Compare arrival times, rather than just departure times.
hints.zh: 比较到站时刻，不能只看开出时刻。

hints.en: Move forwards by {d:45m} from each departure.
hints.zh: 从各班开出时刻往后跳 {d:45m}。

hints.en: For the earliest bus, jump {d:40m} to {t:18:45|24}, then {d:5m} more.

correct.en: Yes. Bus A arrives at {t:18:50|24}, before the marked deadline.
correct.zh: 对。A 班巴士 {t:18:50|24} 到站，比标出的期限早。

say.en: 25 + 45 = 70 minutes includes a full hour. Bus B arrives at {t:19:10|24}; carry at 60 minutes before comparing.
say.zh: 25 + 45 = 70 分钟，其中有一整小时。B 班巴士 {t:19:10|24} 到站；要满 60 分钟进一小时，再比较。

say.en: Subtracting the ride time from Bus C gives an earlier time. Arrival needs addition; Bus C reaches the stop at {t:20:00|24}.
say.zh: 从 C 班开出时刻减去车程，会得到更早的时刻。到站要用加法；C 班 {t:20:00|24} 才到。

fallback.en: Not yet. Add {d:45m} to each departure and choose an arrival before the mark.
fallback.zh: 还没对。各班开出时刻加上 {d:45m}，选到站时刻在标记之前的一班。

reveal.en: Bus A arrives at {t:18:50|24}, Bus B at {t:19:10|24}, and Bus C at {t:20:00|24}. Only Bus A arrives before {t:19:00|24}.

prompt.en: Arjun needs to reach the stop before {t:16:00|24}. Each ride takes {d:35m}. Which bus should he take?
prompt.zh: Arjun 须在 {t:16:00|24} 前到站，车程均为 {d:35m}。坐哪班？

guide.en: Work out each arrival in 24-hour time. Remember that the ride happens after departure.
guide.zh: 用 24 时制求各班的到站时刻。留意车程是在开出之后经过的时间。

hints.en: The mark shows the time Arjun must arrive before.
hints.zh: 标记是 Arjun 必要在这之前到达的时刻。

hints.en: Add {d:35m} to each bus departure, carrying at 60 minutes.
hints.zh: 各班开出时刻加上 {d:35m}，满 60 分钟要进一小时。

hints.en: Check the bus leaving at {t:15:20|24}: 20 + 35 minutes stays within the same hour.
hints.zh: 看 {t:15:20|24} 开出的一班：20 + 35 分钟还在同一小时内。

correct.en: Yes. Bus E arrives at {t:15:55|24}, which is before {t:16:00|24}.

say.en: Taking {d:35m} away from Bus D goes backwards. Add the ride time: it arrives at {t:16:45|24}, after the deadline.
say.zh: 从 D 班开出时刻减去 {d:35m}，方向反了。应加上车程；它 {t:16:45|24} 才到，已过期限。

say.en: 40 + 35 = 75 minutes passes the hour at 60. Bus F arrives at {t:16:15|24}; regroup before comparing it with the deadline.
say.zh: 40 + 35 = 75 分钟，满 60 分钟就跨过整点。F 班 {t:16:15|24} 到；先换成小时和分钟，再与期限比较。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the arrival for each departure, then compare it with {t:16:00|24}.
fallback.zh: 还没对。求出各班的到站时刻，再与 {t:16:00|24} 比较。

reveal.en: Bus D arrives at {t:16:45|24}, Bus E at {t:15:55|24}, and Bus F at {t:16:15|24}. Take Bus E to arrive before {t:16:00|24}.

prompt.en: What time does the clock show?
prompt.zh: 钟面上是几点几分？

guide.en: Short hand for the hour, long hand for the minutes, counting in 5s.
guide.zh: 短针读时，长针读分，5 个 5 个地数。

hints.en: The long hand is on 4: count 5, 10, 15, 20.

correct.en: Yes. The hour hand is just past 7, the minute hand on 4: {t:7:20|face}.
correct.zh: 对。时针刚过 7，分针指着 4：{t:7:20|face}。

say.en: On the minute hand, 4 means 4 fives: 20 minutes.
say.zh: 对分针来说，4 是 4 个 5 分钟：20 分。

say.en: The long hand shows the minutes and the short hand shows the hour.
say.zh: 长针表示分，短针表示时。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the short hand first, then count in 5s to the long hand.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先读短针，再 5 个 5 个地数到长针。

reveal.en: The short hand is just past 7 and the long hand is on 4 (20 minutes): {t:7:20|face}.
reveal.zh: 短针刚过 7，长针指着 4（20 分）：{t:7:20|face}。

prompt.en: Set the clock to {t:2:50|face}.
prompt.zh: 把钟拨到 {t:2:50|face}。

guide.en: Put the minute hand on the number for 50 minutes. Watch where the hour hand stops.
guide.zh: 把分针拨到表示 50 分的数上，看看时针停在哪里。

hints.en: 50 minutes is at the 10. The hour hand should be close to 3 but not on it.
hints.zh: 50 分在 10 那里。时针应该接近 3，但还没到。

correct.en: Yes. The minute hand is on 10, and the hour hand is nearly at 3 but has not reached it.
correct.zh: 对。分针指着 10，时针快到 3，但还没到。

say.en: The hour hand has gone past 3, so that is a time after 3. At {t:2:50|face} it has not reached 3.
say.zh: 时针已经过了 3，那是 3 点多。{t:2:50|face} 时，时针还没到 3。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the number the minute hand is on, and where the hour hand is.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看分针指着几，时针在哪里。

reveal.en: {t:2:50|face}: the minute hand on 10, the hour hand most of the way from 2 to 3.
reveal.zh: {t:2:50|face}：分针指着 10，时针从 2 往 3 走了一大半。

prompt.en: Which clock shows {t:4:45|face}?
prompt.zh: 哪个钟是 {t:4:45|face}？

guide.en: Check both hands on each clock.
guide.zh: 每个钟的两根针都要看。

hints.en: The hour hand should be between 4 and 5, nearer to 5.
hints.zh: 时针应该在 4 和 5 之间，离 5 更近。

correct.en: Yes. The minute hand is on 9 and the hour hand is three quarters of the way to 5.
correct.zh: 对。分针指着 9，时针往 5 走了四分之三。

say.en: That clock’s hour hand is right on 4. At {t:4:45|face} it has moved most of the way to 5.
say.zh: 那个钟的时针正指着 4。{t:4:45|face} 时，它已经快到 5 了。

say.en: That clock’s hour hand has passed 5: it shows a time after 5.
say.zh: 那个钟的时针已经过了 5，是 5 点多。

say.en: On that clock the long and short hands have changed places.
say.zh: 那个钟的长针和短针换了位置。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for the minute hand on 9 and the hour hand between 4 and 5.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找分针指着 9、时针在 4 和 5 之间的钟。

reveal.en: Clock C: the minute hand on 9, the hour hand between 4 and 5, close to 5.
reveal.zh: C 钟：分针指着 9，时针在 4 和 5 之间，靠近 5。

prompt.en: {d:2h15m} = ? min

guide.en: Each hour is 60 minutes.
guide.zh: 每小时是 60 分钟。

correct.en: Yes. 60 + 60 + 15 = 135 minutes.

say.en: An hour is 60 minutes, not 100: 60 + 60 + 15.

fallback.en: Not yet. Change each hour into 60 minutes, then add the 15.
fallback.zh: 还没对。每小时换成 60 分钟，再加 15。

prompt.en: A film starts at {t:14:40} and ends at {t:16:15}. How long is it?
prompt.zh: 电影 {t:14:40} 开始，{t:16:15} 结束。放了多长时间？

guide.en: Jump to the next hour, then whole hours, then the minutes left.
guide.zh: 先跳到整点，再跳整小时，最后跳剩下的分钟。

hints.en: 20 min to {t:15:00}, 1 h to {t:16:00}, then 15 min.

correct.en: Yes. 20 min + 1 h + 15 min = {d:1h35m}.

say.en: 4.15 − 2.40 as ordinary numbers gives 1.75, but an hour has 60 minutes. Jump to {t:15:00} first.
say.zh: 把 4.15 − 2.40 当普通的数来减得 1.75，可 1 小时只有 60 分钟。先跳到 {t:15:00}。

say.en: That is one hour too many: count the jumps between hour marks, not the marks.
say.zh: 多了 1 小时：数整点之间跳了几段，不是数有几个整点。

fallback.en: Not yet. Jump to the next hour first.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先跳到下一个整点。

prompt.en: A swimming lesson starts at {t:10:45} and lasts {d:50m}. When does it end?
prompt.zh: 游泳课 {t:10:45} 开始，上 {d:50m}。几点结束？

guide.en: Jump to {t:11:00} first, then add the minutes left.
guide.zh: 先跳到 {t:11:00}，再加上剩下的分钟。

hints.en: 15 minutes to {t:11:00}; 35 are left.

correct.en: Yes. 15 minutes to {t:11:00}, then 35 more: {t:11:35}.

say.en: 45 + 50 = 95, but at 60 minutes the clock reaches the next hour.
say.zh: 45 + 50 = 95，可满 60 分钟就到下一个整点了。

say.en: {t:11:35} is still before noon, so it stays am.
say.zh: {t:11:35} 还没到中午 12 点，所以还是 am。

fallback.en: Not yet. Jump to the next hour first.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先跳到下一个整点。

prompt.en: Write {t:19:20} in 24-hour time.

guide.en: After noon, add 12 to the hour.
guide.zh: 中午以后，小时数加 12。

say.en: Afternoon and evening hours are 12 more, not 10 more: 7 + 12 = 19.
say.zh: 下午和晚上的小时数要加 12，不是加 10：7 + 12 = 19。

fallback.en: Not yet. It is after noon: add 12 to the hour.
fallback.zh: 还没对。这是中午以后：小时数加 12。

prompt.en: A bus reached the interchange at {t:15:05|24} after a {d:40m} ride. When did it leave? Write 24-hour time.
prompt.zh: 巴士 {t:15:05|24} 到换乘站，路上 {d:40m}。几点开出的？用 24 时制写。

guide.en: Go back from {t:15:05|24}: first to {t:15:00|24}, then the minutes left.

hints.en: Back 5 minutes to {t:15:00|24}; 35 more to go back.
hints.zh: 退 5 分钟到 {t:15:00|24}，还要再退 35 分钟。

correct.en: Yes. Back 5 min to {t:15:00|24}, back 35 min to {t:14:25|24}.

say.en: That is 40 minutes after it arrived. The bus left before it arrived, so go back.
say.zh: 那是到站以后再过 40 分钟。巴士一定先开出、后到站，所以要往回推。

say.en: There is no 65 minutes past an hour. Going back past {t:15:00|24}, count down from 60.
say.zh: 没有"几点 65 分"。往回退过 {t:15:00|24} 时，分钟从 60 往下退。

fallback.en: Not yet. Go back from {t:15:05|24} to the hour first.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先从 {t:15:05|24} 退到整点。
